text:
sam: quick q — PR #9876 touches runtime/telemetry/collector.go and infra/k8s/telemetry-deploy.yaml. CODEOWNERS points at @runtime-team and @eng-infra. runtime lead is OOO until Thu. who can LGTM and merge this before tomorrow's deploy?

codeowner-bot: According to CODEOWNERS, required reviewers: @runtime-team, @eng-infra. No approved reviewers listed on the PR.

alex: ping @maria @jen — is either of you ok to review the runtime bit? it's a tiny change (2 lines) that toggles a metric label.

maria: looking now. small change, lgtm from runtime side as long as unit tests pass.

jen: infra side — the k8s manifest tweak is a one-line env var rename. @eng-infra owns manifests in infra/k8s. I can approve after CI passes.

sam: thanks. CI is currently flaky — ci-bot reported a transient failure earlier. @ci-bot can you re-run tests? need green for merge.

ci-bot: re-run triggered by @sam. Tests queued. ETA ~7m.

leah: quick policy note — per our CODEOWNERS rules, if one owner group approves and the other owner group is unavailable, an approver from the "approval-fallback" list can sign off for trivial changes. Fallback list: @eng-platform leads (alex, leah) or oncall.

alex: fyi runtime lead (derek) is OOO so fallback applies. I can proxy-approve infra or runtime if both agree this is trivial.

maria: confirmed trivial. unit tests cover metric name mapping. I'm happy to have @alex proxy-approve if infra gives thumbs.

jen: infra green on my side. go ahead @alex. please add a note in PR comment saying "proxy-approved per eng-platform fallback — change is trivial" and link the oncall if needed.

alex: added comment and approved. "Proxy-approved per eng-platform fallback for small telemetry/manifest rename. Changes < 5 LOC; runtime lead OOO. @leah FYI"

sam: thanks all. I'll merge after CI passes and then monitor the canary deploy. tagging #incidents so ops sees it. :rocket:

ci-bot: all checks passed — green.

sam: merged and deployed to staging. monitoring for 15m.

jen: thanks — noted in release notes. :thumbsup:

leah: thanks team — this follow-the-fallback flow is working as intended. please file a quick retro item if you hit any friction.

sam: will do if anything pops. appreciate the quick turnaround.
